Machine Learning Engineer at Nimbus AI
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
Full-time

About the role
Nimbus AI is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy production ML systems.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience in machine learning or data science
- Strong Python and SQL
- Experience with scikit-learn or PyTorch
- Experience deploying models with Docker on AWS
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics or related field

Nice to have
- Airflow, Kubernetes, MLOps experience

Salary: ₹25 LPA - ₹40 LPA
